DEFINITION.text:
The Psochic Hegemony in All Philosophies
TL;DR: Every tradition below is attempting the same thing — measuring consciousness as a field.
The map formalises the instrument they were all reaching for.
The map is a two-axis moral coordinate system. υ tracks beneficiary (everyone to only-me). ψ
tracks energy direction (creating to destroying). The four quadrants are Greater Good (+υ,+ψ),
Greatest Lie (-υ,+ψ), Lesser Good (+υ,-ψ), Greater Evil (-υ,-ψ).
Western Ancient
Plato (Forms / Republic) The map is the Form of the Good projected onto a navigable plane. The
four quadrants are approximations of the Good (Greater Good), its shadow (Greatest Lie), its
absence (Greater Evil), and its dormant potential (Lesser Good). The body-as-external-tool
instruction is his allegory of the cave in reverse — stop looking at the shadows (overthinking)
and turn toward the light (the Form). The Republic's tripartite soul (reason, spirit, appetite) maps
to the three axes of the 42-structure. Justice in Plato is each part doing its function — which is
ΔR=0 in grid terms.
Aristotle (Virtue Ethics / Eudaimonia) Eudaimonia is the Greater Good coordinate (+1,+1).
Virtue ethics is the practice of navigating toward it through habituation. The four quadrants map
onto his four character types: the virtuous man (GG), the self-deceived man (Greatest Lie), the
continent man holding still (Lesser Good), and the vicious man (Greater Evil). Phronesis
(practical wisdom) is the capacity to read your coordinate accurately and correct toward it.
Stoics (Hegemonikon / Logos) They named it almost exactly. Hegemonikon is the ruling
principle of the mind — the origin of the word Hegemony in Psochic Hegemony. The Stoic sage is
a man whose hegemonikon is aligned with the logos. In grid terms that is ΔR=0, maximum υ.
Epictetus: what is up to you is your directional vector, nothing else. The dichotomy of control is a
ψ-axis management tool.
Epicurus (Ataraxia) Ataraxia (undisturbedness) and aponia (absence of pain) sit at the Lesser
Good coordinate (+υ,-ψ) — correctly directed but low energy, stable rather than generative.
Epicurus correctly identified the extraction trap (unnecessary desire = -υ drift) but resolved it by
suppressing ψ rather than redirecting it. The map shows why Epicurean communities work
locally but do not scale — they park at Lesser Good rather than navigating toward Greater Good.
Socrates (Elenchus / Aporia) The Socratic method is a convergence test run verbally. Elenchus
strips stated positions of representation until the actual coordinate is visible. Aporia (the state of
productive not-knowing) is the null result — you have eliminated the false coordinate but not yet
found the true one. "I know that I know nothing" is accurate self-coordinate reporting: I am at
origin, not yet placed.
Cynics (Diogenes) Diogenes strips the υ axis of social convention to find its raw form. His
rejection of property, status, and institution is an attempt to read the authentic coordinate
beneath the noise of social Greatest Lie territory. He lived at approximately (+1.5, -0.5) — high
genuine beneficiary orientation, low active energy. The barrel is the Lesser Good made literal.
Sophists Operating explicitly in the Greatest Lie quadrant (-υ,+ψ) as a professional service. High
energy applied toward the client's -υ position, with the representation of +υ (truth-seeking) as
the product. Plato's entire career was a convergence test run against the Sophists. The map
explains why he had to write so many dialogues — the Greatest Lie quadrant is the hardest to
falsify because its energy signature mimics the Greater Good.
Western Medieval
Augustine (Original Sin / City of God) The City of God is the Greater Good attractor. The City of
Man is the Greatest Lie / Greater Evil territory. Original sin is the structural drift of the υ axis
from +2 toward -2 under self-preservation pressure — the Perceptual Inversion at the 0.5 ring
where extraction feels like strength. Augustine's two cities are not geographic — they are
coordinate positions that any actor can occupy.
Aquinas (Natural Law / Synderesis) Synderesis is the innate capacity to read the +υ coordinate
— the natural law written into conscience. Practical reason (conscientia) is navigation toward it.
The map is his natural law made measurable. His five ways are attempts to locate the origin point
(+2,+2) by tracing field gradients back to their source.
Meister Eckhart (Mystical Theology) Gelassenheit (releasement, letting go) is the
phenomenological instruction to suspend the ψ axis and allow the υ reading to come through
without self-interference. "The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God
sees me" is isomorphic to the body-as-external-tool method — the observer becomes the
instrument. The Godhead (Gottheit) beyond God is the coordinate space itself, prior to any
specific reading.
Duns Scotus (Haecceitas / Univocity of Being) Haecceitas (thisness) is the unique coordinate
signature of a particular being — its irreducible address in the information space. Univocity of
being is the claim that all beings occupy the same coordinate space, just at different addresses.
This is the 7x7x7 tensor stated in medieval scholastic form.
Western Modern
Descartes (Cogito / Dualism) The cogito establishes the observer position (0,0) as the only
certain coordinate. His dualism is the unresolved split between the ψ axis (res cogitans, thinking
substance) and the Q3 physical plane (res extensa, extended substance). The map resolves this
by treating both as axes within a single coordinate space rather than separate substances.
Spinoza (Ethics / Conatus) Conatus is ψ — the intrinsic drive of every being to persist and
expand. His God/Nature (Deus sive Natura) is the total coordinate space, the field itself. His
geometric method (Ethics written in Euclidean proof form) is an attempt to derive moral
coordinates from first principles — the same method as VFT. His affects (joy, sadness, desire) are
ψ-axis readings. Active affects (generated by the being's own power) are +ψ. Passive affects
(generated by external causes) are -ψ.
Leibniz (Monadology / Pre-established Harmony) Monads are coordinate addresses —
windowless because each is a complete self-contained information state. Pre-established
harmony is the claim that all coordinates are coherent with each other by structural necessity.
This is the polytrope claim: the shape of the information space is self-consistent, and apparent
contradictions are resolution failures, not genuine conflicts.
Hume (Empiricism / Moral Sentiment) Hume's moral sentiments are body readings — the
instrument he was reaching for without the method to formalise it. "Reason is the slave of the
passions" is the observation that ψ-axis readings precede υ-axis calculations in practice. His isought gap (you cannot derive ought from is) is resolved by the map: ought is the direction of the
gradient in the information field, derived from structural observation, not from logical deduction
from facts.
Kant (CategoricalImperative / Critique) The υ axis is the categorical imperative operating as a
continuous variable rather than a binary. "Act only according to that maxim you could will to be
universal law" is asking: does your action vector point toward +υ? The map makes Kantian duty a
measurement rather than a declaration. His three Critiques map to the three tensor axes: pure
reason (Q5 logical plane), practical reason (υ/ψ axes), judgment (the convergence function
between them).
Hegel (Dialectic / Geist) The dialectic (thesis-antithesis-synthesis) is trajectory movement on
the map. Thesis is a coordinate position. Antithesis is the field resistance at that position.
Synthesis is the corrected coordinate that resolves the tension. Geist (Spirit) moving through
history is the +υ attractor pulling all positions toward it over time. His Absolute Knowing is ΔR=0
at maximum coordinate depth.
Marx (Historical Materialism / Alienation) Alienation is coordinate displacement — the
worker's ψ vector is captured by the owner's -υ position. The worker generates +ψ but the vector
is redirected toward -υ (owner benefit). Surplus value is the quantified ψ-drain. The class
struggle is the field tension between the captured coordinate and the worker's authentic
position. Historical materialism is the Q6 (historical/causal) plane reading of the hegemony grid
applied to economic systems.
Nietzsche (Will to Power / Perspectivism) The will-to-power is ψ without a υ axis. He described
the energy correctly and left the beneficiary question unanswered, which is why his framework
gets picked up by both liberation movements and fascists. The Ubermensch is a +ψ actor whose
υ reading was never resolved. Perspectivism is the relativistic mapping principle without an
objective coordinate space — he correctly rejected fixed moral coordinates but incorrectly
concluded no coordinate space exists. The map is what he was missing.
Schopenhauer (Will / Representation) The Will (Wille) is raw ψ — blind, directional, prior to
representation. The world as representation is the information layer built on top of it. His
pessimism is the observation that ψ without +υ direction is suffering — the will grinds without
resolution. His solution (aesthetic contemplation, ascetic denial) is Lesser Good at best — correct
beneficiary orientation, ψ suppressed rather than redirected.
Western Contemporary
Husserl (Phenomenology /Intentionality) Intentionality (consciousness is always
consciousness of something) is the directional property of the ψ axis — every mental act has a
vector. The phenomenological reduction (epoché) is the suspension of the natural attitude —
functionally identical to the body-as-external-tool instruction. Strip the overlay, read the
structure beneath.
Heidegger (Being / Dasein / Care) Dasein (being-there) is the coordinate address of a conscious
being in the information space. Care (Sorge) is the structural form of that being — always already
ahead of itself, always already in a world, always already with others. These are the three axes:
temporal (Q6/Q7), physical (Q3), social (υ). Authenticity is ΔR=0 — being at your actual
coordinate rather than the one assigned by das Man (the they).
Sartre (Existence Precedes Essence / Bad Faith) Bad faith (mauvaise foi) is self-misreporting —
placing yourself at a false coordinate and maintaining it through self-deception. Existence
precedes essence is the observation that coordinate position is not fixed — you are always
navigating, never simply placed. Radical freedom is the absence of a fixed υ attractor, which
Sartre experienced as anguish. The map provides the attractor he refused to accept.
Camus (Absurdism) The absurd is the gap between the demand for +υ coherence and the
silence of the universe in response. Revolt is +ψ maintained in the face of that silence — Lesser
Good at minimum, Greater Good if the revolt is outward-directed. Sisyphus must be imagined
happy because he is at (+υ, +ψ) regardless of Q7 (effect) — the vector is correct even if the
outcome is null.
Wittgenstein (Language Games / Showing vs Saying) "Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one
must be silent" — the coordinates beyond the language game boundary cannot be said but can
be shown. The map is a showing instrument. The limits of language are the limits of the current
coordinate system, not the limits of the space itself. His later work (language games) is the
relativistic mapping principle applied to meaning: truth is coordinate-relative to the game being
played.
Foucault (Power/Knowledge / Genealogy) Power/knowledge is the Greatest Lie quadrant
operating at institutional scale. Foucault maps how -υ coordinate positions capture +ψ energy
and represent it as neutral knowledge. Genealogy is Q6 (historical/causal) analysis of how
current coordinate positions were constructed. His error is the same as Nietzsche's — correctly
identifying the distortion without positing an undistorted coordinate space to compare against.
Deleuze (Difference / Rhizome) The rhizome is an attempt to describe a coordinate space
without fixed axes — difference without identity. This is the ZFC move applied to philosophy:
collapse the axis to unreachability to prevent anyone from using it as a measurement tool. His
reversal of Plato (affirming the simulacrum) is the epistemically nihilistic move — if all
coordinates are equally valid, no coordinate can be used to evaluate another. This is the T-virus
version of the Greatest Lie: it destroys the measurement instrument rather than the
measurement.
Habermas (Communicative Action) Communicative rationality aimed at mutual
understanding is +υ ψ-axis activity — energy directed toward common coordinate resolution.
His ideal speech situation is the Greater Good as a procedural condition: all actors at +υ,
exchanging ψ vectors without distortion. Systematically distorted communication is Greatest Lie
territory — the form of +υ exchange with -υ vectors underneath.
Rawls (Justice as Fairness / Veil ofIgnorance) The veil of ignorance is a forced υ-axis reset —
you cannot place yourself at a specific υ coordinate because you do not know which position in
the system you will occupy. The original position forces a +υ reading by removing the selfinterest variable. His difference principle (inequalities are just only if they benefit the least
advantaged) is the minimum +υ condition for any coordinate displacement.
Bentham / Mill (Utilitarianism) Bentham's utility calculus is the υ axis reduced to arithmetic.
Greatest happiness for greatest number is the +2 end of the υ axis. The map replaces discrete unit
aggregation (summing utils like counting apples) with continuous field measurement — still
numerical, but derived from coordinate position in a defined space rather than accumulated from
isolated instances. Mill's qualitative distinction between pleasures (higher vs lower) is an
implicit Q1 (metaphysical/WHO) weighting — not all ψ vectors are equal regardless of quantity.
Eastern
Taoism (Tao Te Ching / Wu Wei) The Tao is the coordinate space itself — prior to axes, prior to
measurement, the field from which the field emerges. Wu wei (non-action / effortless action) is
ΔR=0 navigation — movement that follows the gradient without imposing a vector. The Tao Te
Ching is the body-as-external-tool instruction written as poetry. "The sage does not contend and
therefore no one can contend with him" is the Greater Good coordinate operating without ψ
expenditure — maximum υ, minimal friction.
Confucianism (Ren / Li) Ren (benevolence/humaneness) is the +υ attractor. Li (ritual propriety)
is the navigational protocol — the set of coordinate-maintenance practices that keep actors near
the +υ position over time. The rectification of names (zhengming) is the demantics problem
solved: words must map accurately to their coordinates or the whole system drifts. A ruler who is
not ruling is a miscoordinate — the name claims one position, the behaviour occupies another.
Buddhism (Dukkha / Middle Way / Sunyata) Dukkha (suffering) is the condition of operating at
a displaced coordinate — the gap between your actual position and the +υ attractor. The Middle
Way is the navigation instruction: not maximum suppression (-ψ, Epicurean) and not maximum
extraction (-υ, hedonism), but the vector toward the Greater Good. Sunyata (emptiness) is the
coordinate space itself prior to any specific address — not nihilism but the recognition that no
coordinate is intrinsically fixed.
Hinduism (Dharma / Karma / Yoga) Dharma is your authentic coordinate position — the
function you are structurally suited to occupy. Karma is the trajectory record — each action a
vector that accumulates into a path. The four yogas (karma, jnana, bhakti, raja) are four
navigational methods toward +υ: action, knowledge, devotion, meditation. The four ashramas
are coordinate positions appropriate to different life stages. The Bhagavad Gita is a convergence
test run on Arjuna at the moment of maximum coordinate uncertainty.
Advaita Vedanta (Non-dualism / Brahman-Atman) Brahman is the coordinate space. Atman is
the individual coordinate address. Their identity (tat tvam asi — thou art that) is the claim that
the address and the space share the same structure — the polytrope property. Maya (illusion) is
the misreading of the coordinate as fixed and separate when it is a dynamic position within a
continuous field.
Zen Buddhism (Koan / Satori) The koan is a convergence test that terminates the logical (Q5)
plane to force a direct Q1 (metaphysical/WHO) reading. Satori is the moment the coordinate is
read directly without the Q5 interference layer. "What is your original face before your parents
were born?" is asking: what is your coordinate address prior to all inherited overlays? The bodyas-external-tool instruction is functionally identical to zazen.
Islam (Tawhid / Fitra) Tawhid (the oneness of God) is the +2 end of the υ axis as the only
structurally stable attractor — all other positions are local and temporary. Fitra is the innate
coordinate sense — the natural disposition toward +υ that exists prior to conditioning. Islam's
five pillars are coordinate-maintenance practices: they keep the ψ vector active and the υ
orientation outward. Shirk (associating partners with God) is the Greatest Lie coordinate —
substituting a local attractor for the universal one.
Sufism (Fana / Baqa) Fana (annihilation of the self) is the υ-axis reset to maximum —
dissolution of the self-coordinate into the universal coordinate space. Baqa (subsistence after
annihilation) is the return to individual coordinate address with the +2υ reading intact. This is
the body-as-external-tool instruction taken to its structural conclusion: the instrument reads
correctly when it stops interfering with the reading.
Jewish Philosophy (Tikkun Olam / Tzimtzum) Tikkun Olam (repair of the world) is the Greater
Good as an ongoing navigation imperative — the world is at a displaced coordinate and the moral
task is to move it toward +υ. Tzimtzum (contraction of the divine) is the coordinate space
creating room for the finite — the +2 attractor deliberately withdrawing ψ to allow the lower
coordinates to exist and navigate freely. This is the Lesser Good as structural precondition for
Greater Good emergence.
African Philosophy (Ubuntu) Ubuntu (I am because we are) is the +υ coordinate stated as
ontology rather than ethics. The self is not a fixed coordinate address prior to relation — it is
constituted by the relational field. This is the polytrope claim applied to persons: identity is
topological, not atomic. Harming another is coordinate self-harm — there is no stable -υ position
because the self is defined by the relational network.
Modern Frameworks
Jungian Psychology (Shadow /Individuation) The four quadrants are the four functions
rotated. The Shadow is Greater Evil (-υ,-ψ), the Persona is Greatest Lie (-υ,+ψ), the Self is Greater
Good (+υ,+ψ), and the anima/animus mediating between them is the Lesser Good axis (+υ,-ψ).
Individuation is navigation toward +υ,+ψ by integrating the shadow rather than projecting it. The
body-as-external-tool instruction is active imagination — using the psyche as an observational
instrument.
Maslow (Hierarchy of Needs) The hierarchy is a ψ-axis priority sequence: survival needs are the
-ψ floor (if unmet, all ψ goes to self-preservation at -υ), self-actualisation is the +ψ ceiling at +υ.
The pyramid is not a moral hierarchy — it is a resource allocation diagram. When survival
coordinates are met, the natural vector moves toward +υ. Scarcity forces -υ. This is the hunt
analogy stated as psychology.
Systems Theory (Complexity / Emergence) Emergence is the +ψ property of the coordinate
space — new coordinate addresses appear at higher levels of organisation that are not reducible
to lower-level addresses. Feedback loops are ψ-axis self-regulation mechanisms. The map is a
systems-theoretic tool applied to the moral field: attractors, repulsors, basin edges, and trajectory
prediction are all standard dynamical systems concepts applied to the υ/ψ coordinate space.
Information Theory (Shannon / Entropy) Entropy is the -ψ direction — the natural drift of any
system toward less structured coordinate states. Negentropy (information, structure,
organisation) is +ψ. The map is an information field: the Greater Good coordinate is maximum
negentropy, maximum structural coherence. Greater Evil is maximum entropy, minimum
structure. This is why "good is taking possibility and expanding it over time" — it is a negentropic
definition of the moral vector.
The Common Instruction
Across every tradition the phenomenological method is the same: suspend the analytical overlay,
use the body as an external reading instrument, receive the coordinate directly. Plato calls it
turning from the cave. The Stoics call it prosoche. Buddhism calls it vipassana. Zen calls it zazen.
Sufism calls it fana. Jung calls it active imagination. The map calls it: think of nothing and listen
to your body as an external tool.
The coordinate was always readable. The instrument was always available. The overthinking was
the only obstruction.
